subject: CSA/CAIQ evidence: data-flow inventory, owners, and timeline
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@bluemarblehealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: security_ops@bluemarblehealth.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 16:14:00 -0700
Subject: CSA: follow-up on CAIQ inventory and data-flow evidence

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our vendor review we need a CAIQ package that maps each CSA control to the specific evidence artifacts and control owners in your org. In particular our security team is focused on the data-flow picture for PII and PHI: where tokens are stored, KMS usage, key rotation, and deletion timelines.

Can you provide the following items by EOD Friday 25 Jul?
- A CAIQ mapping spreadsheet that lists control IDs, short answers, and direct artifact references (e.g. S3 path / Drive link or log name).
- An updated data-flow diagram annotated with storage locations and retention windows.
- Owner names and emails for each control mapping.
- Any relevant KMS/HSM policies and SOC-2 log-retention policy excerpts.

If you need more time let us know; we are trying to close the tech review early next week.

Best,
Alice
Alice Nguyen
Security Engineer, BlueMarble Health
attachment: none

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@bluemarblehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CSA: follow-up on CAIQ inventory and data-flow evidence

Alice, thanks for the clear ask — we can get most of this over to you by Friday. Internal owners below; I've created a tracking sheet and put initial artifacts into a shared folder (link below).

Quick owner roster:
- Data-flow diagram / architecture annotations: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.ai)
- CAIQ control mapping (spreadsheet): Mina Haddad (mina_haddad@redwood.ai)
- KMS/HSM key policy & rotation logs: Laura Bennett (laura_bennett@redwood.ai)

Plan: Mina will draft the CAIQ mapping CSV and include direct links to artifacts. Marissa will update the data-flow PDF to show tokenization boundaries and retention windows. Laura will extract a short excerpt of our KMS rotation policy and point you to the audit log entries. I'll review and consolidate into a single zip.

Deliverables and timeline:
- 23 Jul COB: initial CAIQ mapping v1 (spreadsheet) + folder of artifacts (partial)
- 24 Jul AM: updated data-flow diagram v2 (PDF)
- 24 Jul EOD: consolidated package (mapping + diagrams + policy excerpts + list of log artifact names)

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cREDACTED

If BlueMarble needs hashes or signed attestation for any file, call that out and we'll add the appropriate export.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
attachment: tracking-sheet.csv (created)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 24 Jul 2025 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CSA: follow-up on CAIQ inventory and data-flow evidence

Looping in a quick status update — I uploaded data_flow_diagram_v2.pdf into the shared folder. Changes: annotated persistent stores (s3://redwood-tokens-prod), streaming cache (in-memory shards), and downstream telemetry buckets. Retention windows are called out for each store (30d cache, 365d analytics, 0-7d ephemeral tokens depending on customer config).

Notes / open items for BlueMarble:
- We do not currently log full plaintext tokens; logs contain token IDs and operation metadata. If you require token-level logs we'll need an approved runbook and risk exception.
- For KMS, we namespace keys per customer and rotate monthly; Laura will pull key rotation entries from the KMS audit trail (cloud-provider-audit-logs).
- There are a few CAIQ controls where we depend on underlying cloud provider attestations (e.g., physical controls) — we've marked those as "referenced evidence" in the spreadsheet.

Attachments uploaded: data_flow_diagram_v2.pdf, redwood_caiq_mapping_v1.xlsx

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Staff Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference
attachment: data_flow_diagram_v2.pdf, redwood_caiq_mapping_v1.xlsx

From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@bluemarblehealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: security_ops@bluemarblehealth.com
Date: Thu, 24 Jul 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CSA: follow-up on CAIQ inventory and data-flow evidence

Karthik / team — appreciate the fast turnaround and the folder link. We reviewed the mapping and diagram; a couple quick asks before final acceptance:
- Can you provide the KMS key rotation audit entries for June and July (file-level export or Drive link)?
- Please confirm whether any long-term backups (snapshots) may contain unmasked tokens and the retention period for those snapshots.
- For CAIQ control CCSL-2.1 (Encryption in transit for inter-service comms) we need the exact cipher suite and TLS minimum version used on internal service-to-service traffic.

If you can get those three items by EOD today that will close our technical review. If not, propose the earliest time you can provide them and we'll coordinate a short follow-up call.

Thanks,
Alice
Security Engineer, BlueMarble Health
attachment: none
